description: This is a Dart source file defining the AppState class, which manages the in-memory state of a personal expense tracker app. It holds transaction data, user preferences, filters, and budget goals, providing methods for data manipulation and retrieval, and notifying listeners of changes.

classes.name: AppState
classes.description: Manages the application's state related to transactions, filters, and budget goals, providing reactive notification capabilities.

methods.name: AppState
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the AppState instance.

methods.name: transactions
methods.description: Returns a list of filtered and sorted transactions based on current filters and search query.

methods.name: isRefreshing
methods.description: Indicates whether the state is currently refreshing.

methods.name: filterType
methods.description: Returns the current type filter (income or expense).

methods.name: budgetGoals
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable map of budget goals per category.

methods.name: totalIncome
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total income from all transactions.

methods.name: totalExpenses
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total expenses from all transactions.

methods.name: totalBalance
methods.description: Calculates and returns the net balance (income minus expenses).

methods.name: formattedBalance
methods.description: Returns the total balance formatted as a locale-specific currency string.

methods.name: categoryExpenseTotals
methods.description: Returns a map with total expenses per category.

methods.name: setFilter
methods.description: Sets the active filter for transaction type and category, then notifies listeners.

methods.name: setSearch
methods.description: Updates the search query and notifies listeners.

methods.name: clearFilters
methods.description: Clears all filters and search query, then notifies listeners.

methods.name: setBudget
methods.description: Updates the budget goal for a specific category and notifies listeners.

methods.name: addTransaction
methods.description: Adds a new transaction to the state and notifies listeners.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Simulates a refresh action, setting the refreshing flag and resetting after a delay.

methods.name: seedSampleData
methods.description: Populates the state with sample transactions if it is empty.
